long_description: Neurogram™ is a Brazilian B2B medtech startup founded in 2021, specializing in AI-driven analysis of EEG (electroencephalogram) data. The platform detects neuro-biomarkers for neurological diseases such as epilepsy and Alzheimer's, significantly improving diagnostic accuracy from 70% to 97% while reducing evaluation time and costs. Founded in São Paulo by neuroscientist Daniele de Mari and neurophysiologist Heitor Ettori, Neurogram aims to enhance healthcare efficiency in critical care settings. The core platform automates the storage, management, and analysis of EEG exams, providing one-click instant reports. It is designed to support real-time monitoring and is accessible from anywhere, ensuring secure and efficient data handling. Neurogram has raised $1.02M in Seed VC and additional funding to expand its platform and team. The company is focused on future developments, including integrating EEG with wearables and genomics, and establishing clinical partnerships. Notably, it serves prominent healthcare providers, including Brazil’s largest brain research center, Instituto Estadual do Cérebro Paulo Niemeyer.

long_description: Noxus is the process intelligence layer for enterprises running complex operations across legacy systems. The platform maps processes, monitors execution, and governs how AI agents, people and existing systems work together. Complex processes rarely produce a deterministic answer for every case. They depend on documents, policies, judgement and exceptions. Noxus makes that logic explicit, including where AI can act, where rules apply and where people need to intervene. The most complex processes are often the ones most worth rebuilding. Noxus is where processes are defined through states, rules, human intervention and agent decisions. Inputs move through the process from triage and enrichment to execution and audit. Data movement, access and hosting remain controlled throughout. Legacy systems remain authoritative for the data they own, while teams define how agents are evaluated and where human judgement stays in the process. The platform deploys in your cloud or on-premise and integrates with 400+ enterprise systems across ERP, CRM, ITSM and custom applications. Every action is recorded and available for review, audit and compliance. We work with Santander, Fidelidade, Sky, Abanca and other organisations running documentation-heavy processes in regulated environments.

long_description: Numalis provides tools and develops ISO standards to facilitate the adoption of AI throughout the industry. Its disruptive innovation helps design artificial intelligence algorithms to make them more robust and explainable. Through its Saimple tools range, Numalis enables AI engineers to address two issues that slow down the adoption of AI: proving their robustness and their explainability. In addition to its AICET solution, Numalis enables companies to assess and certify their employees’ AI proficiency in accordance with the AFNOR Spec 2401 standard. To address these issues, Numalis’ tools are the first to rely on formal methods capable of satisfying the stringent safety requirements of sectors such as transportation, defense, healthcare and even finance.

long_description: Neurocle is a leading and innovative deep learning vision software company. Our vision is to make deep learning vision technology more accessible.
